target_customer: US car dealership groups, specifically fixed operations and service departments that employ repair technicians
problem: Dealerships lack enough skilled technicians, repairs are not standardized, and technicians spend time on admin such as warranty write-ups. Expert repair knowledge stays in technicians' heads.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to dealership groups, likely contract based (company reports contracted ARR); pricing not public
product_category: AI repair guidance and service workflow automation for automotive dealers

founders.name: Kaustubh Bansal
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built voice AI deployed across Indian government and public enterprises.

founders.name: Shubham Goyal
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built the credit underwriting engine at Navi and an early version of the Scapia mobile app.

competitors.name: Tekion
competitors.what: Dealer management system that launched a technician AI agent taking voice or visual input with vehicle history
competitors.traction_then: Large installed DMS base; announced at NADA 2026

competitors.name: Elevat
competitors.what: OEM and dealer branded AI technician assistant with step by step repair guidance

competitors.name: mykaarma
competitors.what: Dealer service communication platform with AI tech video grader

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing voice and video from technicians and structuring symptom, diagnosis, fix and outcome data is feasible with current multimodal models. The hard part is accuracy and compliance with manufacturer specs across many models.

defensibility.rationale: The repair knowledge corpus grows with each captured repair and dealer workflows embed the product, but DMS vendors and OEM tools can ship similar assistants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Tekion announced a technician AI agent in 2026 around the same time; no outcome for Bayworks yet.

market_need_then: The company says over a million cars a day need repair in the US and there are not enough technicians. Its site claims 80+ dealerships and the YC page claims nearly seven figures in cARR across 6 dealer groups (company claims, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses bayworks.app rather than a .com; no acquisition story found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and aspirational; tagline about intelligence that keeps vehicles running; call to action is Book a demo

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is brand new with no press or community evidence found; a branding search returned nothing about it.

outcome_analysis: Bayworks is a Fall 2026 company only months old, so there is no outcome yet. It reports fast early traction with dealer groups, a technical founding team from Indian fintech and voice AI, and a clear shortage of technicians as the pain, but also faces dealer software incumbents launching technician AI in 2026.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed round, seen only on that single aggregator with no investors, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Traction figures are company claims; YC page and site differ (80+ dealerships vs 6 dealer groups). Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. No branding sources found.
